LanguageData.DCP_Intro: While a drafted player-controlled pawn is executing an explicit player-forced job, ordinary autonomous jobs cannot replace it.
LanguageData.DCP_EnableDesc: When enabled, a drafted pawn's current player-forced job cannot be replaced by a non-player-forced StartJob request.
LanguageData.DCP_LogBlockedDesc: Developer diagnostic option. Logs each blocked StartJob request. Leave off during normal play.
